data.name: Anbarin
data.gender_notes: Anbarin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: أنبار جمع نابِر، نابِر جمع نُبل ونُبْل، نابِر بمعنى الشيء النفيس، نابِر جمع نُبل ونُبْل، نُبْل بمعنى الشيء الثمين والمُعتَبر. The name Anbarin carries the meaning “Fragrant, Amber-like” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Anbarin usually hope their child will grow to embody fragrant, amber-like and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anbarin represents a soul that shines with inner light, much like the golden glow of amber—a gemstone believed to hold healing and protective energies.
data.etymology: Anbarin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fragrant, Amber-like.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anbarin total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
